news.title: 7,000 CRPF personnel pulled from Chattisgarh, Bengal deployed in Delhi ahead of CJP’s October 10 protest
news.summary: CRPF personnel asked to carry latest anti-riot equipment, operational-scale weapons, and prescribed ammunition; Home Minister Amit Shah stays put in Delhi to monitor the situation, cancels all visits outside Delhi

news.title: Opposition leaders ‘pray’ at Rajghat for government to ‘get wisdom’ to remove CEC; say protest will continue
news.summary: On INDIA bloc’s third day of protest in Delhi against ‘vote chori’, a show of Opposition unity as SP, Shiv Sena (UBT), NCP (SP) leaders present for lunch hosted by Congress president Kharge

news.title: Elon Musk asks why Starlink still lacks India licence, gets a reply from Rahul Gandhi
news.summary: SpaceX CEO Musk noted that while Starlink is licensed in 165 countries, it has spent five years complying with Indian laws and government requirements.

news.title: Kangana Ranaut moves Delhi HC against obscene, AI-generated content

news.title: Journalist alleging harassment by Delhi Police ACP had to endure 25-point questionnaire by Crime Branch
news.summary: Complainant's lawyer alleges questions focused on her personal and professional background and sought to establish the officer’s credibility; no FIR registered

news.title: Days after narrating drought plight to minister, Maharashtra farmer ends life by jumping in well
news.summary: Rajendra Sapate, a resident of Dhop taluka in Mohadi, jumped into a well in a paddy field between 8am and 9am, he said.

news.title: Case filed against Thiruvananthapuram Mayor V.V. Rajesh over Sugathan’s ‘forged’ signatures
news.summary: Mayor serves defamation notice on LDF leader seeking a compensation of ₹5 crore over the allegations regarding the attendance register.

news.title: GST Council unveils reforms to ease refund, registration and reduce litigation

news.title: Mumbai-based activist and AISF delegation allege detention by State police
news.summary: All India Students’ Federation (AISF) members alleged that police attempted to arbitrarily detain a student delegation travelling aboard the 12779 Goa Express from Pune to New Delhi.

news.title: Government notifies CAPF Act amid pending challenge in Supreme Court
news.summary: Serving CAPF officers have challenged the law, which will impact cadre management and the deputation of Indian Police Service officers to senior positions in the Central Armed Police Forces

news.title: ‘Is Ambani the real boss of India’, asks Elon Musk, as Centre refutes bias in Starlink authorisation
news.summary: Reliance Jio chairman Akash Ambani declines to comment when asked about Mr. Musk’s remarks; LoP Rahul Gandhi joined the debate saying, “Wait till you discover the other guy”

news.title: India holds talks with Saudi, Belgium and Bhutan to boost maritime cooperation
news.summary: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal says Saudi Arabia has expressed interest in investing in Indian port projects, including Vadhavan and Galathea Bay

news.title: Delhi Liquor Shops To Stay Shut Tomorrow And Day After Amid Opposition Protests

news.title: Government To Release AI Consultation Paper Within A Month: Ashwini Vaishnaw
news.summary: Speaking at the launch of a MeitY-World Bank report on the promise of AI, Vaishnaw said the exercise would focus on safety, a human-first approach, skilling and ensuring "no person is left behind".

news.title: Punjab Needs Issue-Based Politics, 1984 A Mistake: Punjab Congress Chief Pargat Singh
news.summary: Pargat Singh also addressed one of the Congress's most sensitive historical issues -- the 1984 anti-Sikh riots -- saying what happened was a mistake

news.title: Delhi Police ramp up ‘perception’ campaign, identifies 500 people, 200 social media channels ahead of October 10 protest

news.title: Statewide special enrolment drive for electoral roll revision in Keralam from October 15

news.title: Bihar EOU recovers ₹52 lakh cash, ₹35 lakh ornaments from executive engineer’s premises
